symptom: `describe page` of an association combo box with an On change microflow printed Label/DataSource/OnChange but "No `Attribute:` and no `CaptionAttribute:`" (nightly-20260927-95091765, Mendix 11.12.1); re-executing the description writes an unbound combo box, and mx check then reports CE0642 "Property 'Entity' is required." and "Property 'Caption' is required."
cause: Same as the 2026-10-02 finding: `w.OnChange != ""` in the generic pluggable branch's guard captured the combo box ahead of its own branch. Already fixed on main by the time the mirror was triaged, but the fix arrived inside a merge commit's conflict resolution (64a38bf6), so `git log --no-merges -S` finds nothing and the issue looked live
insight: **When a report does not reproduce on main, build the reporter's own commit before theorising** (`git worktree add <dir> <nightly sha>` + `make build`, about two minutes). Here the reporter's 'Studio Pro-authored' framing led toward storage differences (EntityRef shape, PropertyTypes nesting, widget version), and every one checked out identical; the nightly binary reproduced it in one run on mxcli-authored BSON, and authoring was irrelevant. The tell was in the output itself: DataSource and OnChange survived while both mode-gated fields vanished together, which points at the emitter branch, not the reader. A fix made in a merge resolution is invisible to `--no-merges` history search, so search with merges included (`git log -S` without `--no-merges`) before concluding there is no fix. While verifying, a separate defect turned up: `OnChange: call microflow M.F(P = $dataView1)` on a pluggable widget checks clean and fails mx check CE0117, while `$currentObject` is clean. The regression script uses `$currentObject` so it does not carry that defect
